tool_input.prompt:
In <repo>, branch fix/unconfigured-daemon-loads-nothing (pull the latest commit first if needed — bwk's prior commit 89788e7 already landed on this branch): fix another real finding from local review (code-reviewer).

Problem: `cmd/beadle-daemon/main.go`'s `runCmd`'s `RunE` has:

```go
ownerKeyID, loadCommandsEnabled := resolveDaemonOwnerKeyID(filepath.Join(dataDir, "daemon.json"), resolver, logger)
commands := loadDaemonCommands(cmdDir, gpgBinary, ownerKeyID, loadCommandsEnabled, logger)
logger.Info("commands loaded", "count", len(commands), "dir", cmdDir, "signature_enforcement", ownerKeyID != "")
```

Under the old (pre-beadle-kua) behavior, `signature_enforcement=false` meant exactly "commands were loaded without verification" — an accurate, if insecure, description. After beadle-kua's fix (an absent or unresolvable daemon.json now disables command loading entirely instead of loading unsigned), `signature_enforcement=false` is logged in exactly the state where enforcement is total: zero commands loaded, none unsigned, nothing running at all. A first-time operator (or automated log-based monitoring keyed on this field) reading `count=0 signature_enforcement=false` would reasonably conclude "unverified loading is happening" — the opposite of reality.

Fix: report the actual state distinctly instead of one boolean that now means different things in different branches. Replace the single log call with a branch on `loadCommandsEnabled`:

```go
if loadCommandsEnabled {
    logger.Info("commands loaded", "count", len(commands), "dir", cmdDir, "signature_enforcement", true)
} else {
    logger.Info("commands loaded", "count", len(commands), "dir", cmdDir, "command_loading", "disabled")
}
```

(`loadCommandsEnabled == true` always implies `ownerKeyID != ""` — verified via `resolveDaemonOwnerKeyID`'s only `return ownerKeyID, true` path, which only happens after `cfg.ResolveOwnerKeyID` succeeds — so hardcoding `true` in the enabled branch is not a simplification that loses information, it's removing a redundant computed expression.) Feel free to word the disabled branch's message/field name differently if you find something clearer, as long as it does NOT use the name `signature_enforcement` with a `false` value in the disabled case — that specific field+value pairing is what's misleading.

If any test currently asserts on the exact `"signature_enforcement"` log field/value pair for either the enabled or disabled path (grep `cmd/beadle-daemon/main_test.go` and check for any integration-style test exercising `RunE` directly — note most of the existing tests call `resolveDaemonOwnerKeyID`/`loadDaemonCommands` directly rather than the full `RunE`, so there may be nothing to update here, but check), update it to match. Run `make check`, confirm clean, commit as something like `fix(daemon): stop calling total command-loading disablement "signature_enforcement=false"`, and report back. Do not push.
